engines.engine_xml:
<rocket_engine name="meteor atmosphere-fed engineering sustainer">
    <isp>
        <function>
            <quotient>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/gross-thrust-n</property>
                <max>
                    <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                    <product>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
                        <value>9.8066499999999994</value>
                    </product>
                </max>
            </quotient>
        </function>
    </isp>
    <propflowmax unit="LBS/SEC">0.66138678655463268</propflowmax>
    <mixtureratio>0</mixtureratio>
    <minthrottle>0.000001</minthrottle>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-x-n</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-y-n</property>
    <property value="0">fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-momentum-z-n</property>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/fuel-kg-s" type="pre">
        <product>
            <property>propulsion/engine[1]/fuel-flow-rate-pps</property>
            <value>0.45359237000000002</value>
        </product>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/burned-fuel-kg-s" type="pre">
        <min>
            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
            <product>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                <value>0.080000000000000002</value>
            </product>
        </min>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/total-temperature-k" type="pre">
        <quotient>
            <sum>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
                <product>
                    <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/burned-fuel-kg-s</property>
                    <value>36000000</value>
                </product>
            </sum>
            <max>
                <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                <product>
                    <sum>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
                    </sum>
                    <value>1150</value>
                </product>
            </max>
        </quotient>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/pressure-ratio" type="pre">
        <max>
            <value>1</value>
            <product>
                <value>0.84999999999999998</value>
                <pow>
                    <quotient>
                        <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-enthalpy-w</property>
                        <max>
                            <value>9.9999999999999998e-13</value>
                            <product>
                                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                                <value>558.05555555555554</value>
                                <property>atmosphere/T-R</property>
                            </product>
                        </max>
                    </quotient>
                    <value>3.5</value>
                </pow>
            </product>
        </max>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/exit-speed-m-s" type="pre">
        <sqrt>
            <max>
                <value>0</value>
                <product>
                    <value>2300</value>
                    <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/total-temperature-k</property>
                    <difference>
                        <value>1</value>
                        <pow>
                            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/pressure-ratio</property>
                            <value>-0.24812030075187974</value>
                        </pow>
                    </difference>
                </product>
            </max>
        </sqrt>
    </function>
    <function name="fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[#]/gross-thrust-n" type="pre">
        <product>
            <sum>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/outflow-kg-s</property>
                <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/fuel-kg-s</property>
            </sum>
            <property>fsim/ducted-inlet-v2/engine[1]/exit-speed-m-s</property>
        </product>
    </function>
</rocket_engine>

descriptor.note: PN uses measured radial speed and LOS history. Launch estimates remain separate inertial-midcourse inputs. The admitted receive fit uses WorldWeaponLinks finite modeled transport of accepted platform fusion before guidance can consume an update. This receive-only configuration does not acquire return telemetry.
descriptor.validity: Reduced-order game simulation; equipment performance and damage effectiveness unvalidated.

navigation_gain.note: Retained engineering navigation ratio; no scene-fit or manufacturer calibration.

cue_deg.note: Retained engineering acquisition association cone.

activation_ratio.note: Retained generic activation range / seeker acquisition range.

loft_deg.note: Retained generic supported-midcourse loft angle.

loft_acceleration_g.note: Retained generic loft acceleration multiplier.

max_g.note: Retained generic guidance demand limit; native fin/aerodynamic authority can realize less.

life_s.note: Retained generic guidance/battery execution lifetime assumption.

inertial_midcourse.note: Transcribed existing simulator assumption unchanged. Uncertainty is unquantified; zero does not claim measurement accuracy.

launcher_updates.note: Transcribed existing simulator assumption unchanged. Uncertainty is unquantified; zero does not claim measurement accuracy.

equations: h=unit(v_own_estimated), u=unit(up), g0=9.80665m/s2; P_h(a)=a-h*(h dot a). unit(0)=0 in the native numerical contract.

For a tracking admitted measurement: l=track.direction, d=track.directionRate. If measurementTimeS is present, l=unit(l+d*(frame.timeS-track.sampleTimeS)); derivative d is not re-estimated by guidance.
c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

Only when the reported phase is Midcourse and inertialMidcourse=true: a_s+=sin(clamp(loftRad,0,0.7))*loftAccelerationG*g0*(u-h*(u dot h)); a Lost terminal latch suppresses loft, not permitted inertial estimate fallback.
z=P_h(a_s)+g0*u; G=maxG*g0; command=z when norm(z)<=G, otherwise command=G*z/norm(z). Gravity is included before the total-vector bound.

terminal_next=terminal_previous OR (engineering.version==3 AND tracking); phase=Homing if tracking, else Lost if terminal_next or retained track localId, else Midcourse if estimate present, else Seeking. Invalid calls return default Unguided and do not update the latch; resetGuidanceStateV1 clears it.

supported=result.supported AND (seeker==semi_active_radar OR launcherUpdates); terminal measurements never use hidden target position/velocity. A launcher estimate is a separate permitted input, not a terminal range-rate substitute.
state: terminalAcquiredV3_ latch, reset only through resetGuidanceStateV1
No guidance-owned Cartesian target state or independent optical/RF fit; admitted track/estimate/result epochs are input values.

primary_sources.title: Palumbo, Blauwkamp and Lloyd, Basic Principles of Homing Guidance, JHU APL Technical Digest 29(1), 2010
primary_sources.method: PN LOS reconstruction, sensor availability and finite lateral-acceleration realization; not OEM missile gains

limits: result.valid=true, finite own position/velocity/up, nonnegative finite own age, finite maxG>0 and finite navigationGain>2 are required. V3 own absolute frame time must be finite and nonnegative.

For V3 tracking: a track, nonzero localId, finite nonnegative original track sampleTime<=frame.time, finite nonzero direction, finite directionRate even when rate unavailable, finite admitted optional range>=minimumRange and finite optional rangeRate are required.

Normal PN interpretation assumes nonzero forward own velocity and admitted unit bearing/tangent rate; unit(0)=0 and unnormalised no-measurementTime inputs are numerical interface branches, not physical flight validity claims.

The validity checks do not impose a new freshness window. Receiver delivery, scan completion, association, noise, covariance, rate availability and own-navigation synchronization remain upstream native responsibilities.
The prediction branch is enabled by measurementTimeS presence and uses track.sampleTimeS; it does not use measurementTimeS value or deliveredTimeS as a replacement original epoch.

Only the enabled inertialMidcourse branch validates its estimate as finite with 0<=sampleTime<=frame.time. Estimate presence determines phase even when inertialMidcourse=false, but that disabled branch does not validate/use the estimate for steering or loft.

R=0 or nonclosing inertial estimate produces no PN; eligible Midcourse loft can remain. Loss of tracking is not a commanded zero-acceleration state because gravity and possibly permitted inertial fallback remain.

G limits the demand, not realized aerodynamic/actuator authority. Plant mass/inertia, finite fins/TVC and directional autopilot realization are separate downstream mechanisms and are not proofs of delayed guidance stability.

Shared N and game receiver/model inputs remain engineering assumptions with the original nonzero/unquantified uncertainty records. This is neither OEM identification, hardware calibration nor a claim of 24 distinct guidance laws.
delta: Actual selected receiver=rf_signal.v1; measurement_family=radar; seeker=active_radar.
Unchanged N=3.5, total maxG=35, loft=20deg, loftAccelerationG=2, inertialMidcourse=True, launcherUpdates=True.
Native scale uses the admitted optional radial measurement, not model name. This archive contains 73 tracked packets with radial availability and 69 rate-available packets.
The archived per-model speed/radial/availability population below determines a distinct operating projection; it does not imply a distinct differential guidance law.

archival_input.scope: Archival full24 illustration captured before subsequent receiver/own-frame repairs. Empty producer source epoch and admission_eligible=false are preserved. Current analysis-source hashes do not repair that producer binding.

observed_archival_domain.scope: Publication samples only; counts do not establish fresh decision cardinality, delivery latency, phase duration or current encounter acceptance.

archival_algebraic_example.scope: Archived measured LOS/rate and optional radial measurement with published navigation velocity. Declared up=+z is synthetic. These publication/track/control epochs are not a synchronized native guidance decision; no native-command residual or flight acceptance is inferred.

sensitivity_equations_and_branches: For unsaturated tracking at a fixed admitted l,d,h and capability scale c: da_s/dN=c*((l cross d) cross h), da_s/dc=N*((l cross d) cross h). rateAvailable=false makes both steering sensitivities zero.
c=max(0,-rangeRate): derivative is -1 for strictly negative radial velocity and zero for strictly positive radial velocity; the zero boundary is nonsmooth and must be tested as its own branch.

For z outside the total bound, command Jacobian versus z is G/norm(z)*(I-z*z^T/norm(z)^2); inside it is I. Pure radial rescaling in a saturated direction can leave command unchanged, so parameter perturbation is not automatically nonzero response.

Epoch projection l(tau)=unit(l0+d*tau) has derivative (I-l*l^T)*d/norm(l0+d*tau). With tangent d at tau=0, the derivative of (l cross d) can vanish; do not invent first-order delay sensitivity or substitute Ts/2+processing for an actual capture epoch.
Midcourse loft is zero for the actual zero-loft cards and after a terminal Lost latch. Changing launcherUpdates alone does not create inertialMidcourse or a measured terminal range/range-rate.

equations: h=unit(v_own_estimated), u=unit(up), g0=9.80665m/s2; P_h(a)=a-h*(h dot a). unit(0)=0 in the native numerical contract.

For a tracking admitted measurement: l=track.direction, d=track.directionRate. If measurementTimeS is present, l=unit(l+d*(frame.timeS-track.sampleTimeS)); derivative d is not re-estimated by guidance.
c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

Only when the reported phase is Midcourse and inertialMidcourse=true: a_s+=sin(clamp(loftRad,0,0.7))*loftAccelerationG*g0*(u-h*(u dot h)); a Lost terminal latch suppresses loft, not permitted inertial estimate fallback.
z=P_h(a_s)+g0*u; G=maxG*g0; command=z when norm(z)<=G, otherwise command=G*z/norm(z). Gravity is included before the total-vector bound.

terminal_next=terminal_previous OR (engineering.version==3 AND tracking); phase=Homing if tracking, else Lost if terminal_next or retained track localId, else Midcourse if estimate present, else Seeking. equations: h=unit(v_own_estimated), u=unit(up), g0=9.80665m/s2; P_h(a)=a-h*(h dot a). unit(0)=0 in the native numerical contract.

For a tracking admitted measurement: l=track.direction, d=track.directionRate. If measurementTimeS is present, l=unit(l+d*(frame.timeS-track.sampleTimeS)); derivative d is not re-estimated by guidance.
c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

Only when the reported phase is Midcourse and inertialMidcourse=true: a_s+=sin(clamp(loftRad,0,0.7))*loftAccelerationG*g0*(u-h*(u dot h)); a Lost terminal latch suppresses loft, not permitted inertial estimate fallback.
z=P_h(a_s)+g0*u; G=maxG*g0; command=z when norm(z)<=G, otherwise command=G*z/norm(z). Gravity is included before the total-vector bound.

terminal_next=terminal_previous OR (engineering.version==3 AND tracking); phase=Homing if tracking, else Lost if terminal_next or retained track localId, else Midcourse if estimate present, else Seeking. Invalid calls return default Unguided and do not update the latch; resetGuidanceStateV1 clears it.

supported=result.supported AND (seeker==semi_active_radar OR launcherUpdates); terminal measurements never use hidden target position/velocity. A launcher estimate is a separate permitted input, not a terminal range-rate substitute.

For z outside the total bound, command Jacobian versus z is G/norm(z)*(I-z*z^T/norm(z)^2); inside it is I. Pure radial rescaling in a saturated direction can leave command unchanged, so parameter perturbation is not automatically nonzero response.

limits: result.valid=true, finite own position/velocity/up, nonnegative finite own age, finite maxG>0 and finite navigationGain>2 are required. V3 own absolute frame time must be finite and nonnegative.

For V3 tracking: a track, nonzero localId, finite nonnegative original track sampleTime<=frame.time, finite nonzero direction, finite directionRate even when rate unavailable, finite admitted optional range>=minimumRange and finite optional rangeRate are required.

Normal PN interpretation assumes nonzero forward own velocity and admitted unit bearing/tangent rate; unit(0)=0 and unnormalised no-measurementTime inputs are numerical interface branches, not physical flight validity claims.

The validity checks do not impose a new freshness window. Receiver delivery, scan completion, association, noise, covariance, rate availability and own-navigation synchronization remain upstream native responsibilities.
The prediction branch is enabled by measurementTimeS presence and uses track.sampleTimeS; it does not use measurementTimeS value or deliveredTimeS as a replacement original epoch.

Only the enabled inertialMidcourse branch validates its estimate as finite with 0<=sampleTime<=frame.time. Estimate presence determines phase even when inertialMidcourse=false, but that disabled branch does not validate/use the estimate for steering or loft.

R=0 or nonclosing inertial estimate produces no PN; eligible Midcourse loft can remain. Loss of tracking is not a commanded zero-acceleration state because gravity and possibly permitted inertial fallback remain.

G limits the demand, not realized aerodynamic/actuator authority. Plant mass/inertia, finite fins/TVC and directional autopilot realization are separate downstream mechanisms and are not proofs of delayed guidance stability.

Shared N and game receiver/model inputs remain engineering assumptions with the original nonzero/unquantified uncertainty records. This is neither OEM identification, hardware calibration nor a claim of 24 distinct guidance laws.

R_F=F_measured_theta-F_angle*theta-F_control*delta_actual; R_M=M_measured_axis-M_angle*theta-M_rate*rate-M_control*delta_actual; G=(omega cross J*omega)_axis
rate_ref=-s*(demand_theta+g_theta)/V+s*(demand_x+g_x)*theta_ref/V
(F_angle-F_x+m*demand_x)*theta_ref+F_control*delta_trim+R_F=m*demand_theta; M_angle*theta_ref+M_rate*rate_ref+M_control*delta_trim+R_M-G=0
D=F_angle-F_control*M_angle/M_control-F_x+m*demand_x-s*F_control*M_rate*(demand_x+g_x)/(M_control*V)
theta_ref=[m*demand_theta-R_F+(F_control/M_control)*(M_rate*(-s*(demand_theta+g_theta)/V)+R_M-G)]/D

cascade K=[(J_axis*s/(T_rate*T_incidence)+M_angle)/M_control,(J_axis/T_rate+M_rate)/M_control,0]; closed_A=A-B*K only in frozen unsaturated residual-constant domain

equations: h=unit(v_own_estimated), u=unit(up), g0=9.80665m/s2; P_h(a)=a-h*(h dot a). unit(0)=0 in the native numerical contract.

For a tracking admitted measurement: l=track.direction, d=track.directionRate. If measurementTimeS is present, l=unit(l+d*(frame.timeS-track.sampleTimeS)); derivative d is not re-estimated by guidance.
c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

Only when the reported phase is Midcourse and inertialMidcourse=true: a_s+=sin(clamp(loftRad,0,0.7))*loftAccelerationG*g0*(u-h*(u dot h)); a Lost terminal latch suppresses loft, not permitted inertial estimate fallback.
z=P_h(a_s)+g0*u; G=maxG*g0; command=z when norm(z)<=G, otherwise command=G*z/norm(z). Gravity is included before the total-vector bound.

Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.

rate_ref=-s*(demand_theta+g_theta)/V+s*(demand_x+g_x)*theta_ref/V

For a tracking admitted measurement: l=track.direction, d=track.directionRate. If measurementTimeS is present, l=unit(l+d*(frame.timeS-track.sampleTimeS)); derivative d is not re-estimated by guidance.
c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

Only when the reported phase is Midcourse and inertialMidcourse=true: a_s+=sin(clamp(loftRad,0,0.7))*loftAccelerationG*g0*(u-h*(u dot h)); a Lost terminal latch suppresses loft, not permitted inertial estimate fallback.
z=P_h(a_s)+g0*u; G=maxG*g0; command=z when norm(z)<=G, otherwise command=G*z/norm(z). Gravity is included before the total-vector bound.

equations: h=unit(v_own_estimated), u=unit(up), g0=9.80665m/s2; P_h(a)=a-h*(h dot a). unit(0)=0 in the native numerical contract.

For a tracking admitted measurement: l=track.direction, d=track.directionRate. If measurementTimeS is present, l=unit(l+d*(frame.timeS-track.sampleTimeS)); derivative d is not re-estimated by guidance.
c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

Only when the reported phase is Midcourse and inertialMidcourse=true: a_s+=sin(clamp(loftRad,0,0.7))*loftAccelerationG*g0*(u-h*(u dot h)); a Lost terminal latch suppresses loft, not permitted inertial estimate fallback.
z=P_h(a_s)+g0*u; G=maxG*g0; command=z when norm(z)<=G, otherwise command=G*z/norm(z). Gravity is included before the total-vector bound.

terminal_next=terminal_previous OR (engineering.version==3 AND tracking); phase=Homing if tracking, else Lost if terminal_next or retained track localId, else Midcourse if estimate present, else Seeking. equations: h=unit(v_own_estimated), u=unit(up), g0=9.80665m/s2; P_h(a)=a-h*(h dot a). unit(0)=0 in the native numerical contract.

c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

Only when the reported phase is Midcourse and inertialMidcourse=true: a_s+=sin(clamp(loftRad,0,0.7))*loftAccelerationG*g0*(u-h*(u dot h)); a Lost terminal latch suppresses loft, not permitted inertial estimate fallback.

With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

equations: m*(v_dot_body + omega cross v_body)=F_nongravity_body+m*g_body; J*omega_dot=M-omega cross(J*omega)
pitch s=+1, theta=alpha, rate=q, transverse=z; yaw s=-1, theta=beta, rate=r, transverse=y
theta_dot=s*rate+(F_theta+m*g_theta-(F_x+m*g_x)*theta)/(m*V) in the disclosed small-angle reduction
R_F=F_measured_theta-F_angle*theta-F_control*delta_actual; R_M=M_measured_axis-M_angle*theta-M_rate*rate-M_control*delta_actual; G=(omega cross J*omega)_axis
rate_ref=-s*(demand_theta+g_theta)/V+s*(demand_x+g_x)*theta_ref/V
(F_angle-F_x+m*demand_x)*theta_ref+F_control*delta_trim+R_F=m*demand_theta; M_angle*theta_ref+M_rate*rate_ref+M_control*delta_trim+R_M-G=0
D=F_angle-F_control*M_angle/M_control-F_x+m*demand_x-s*F_control*M_rate*(demand_x+g_x)/(M_control*V)
theta_ref=[m*demand_theta-R_F+(F_control/M_control)*(M_rate*(-s*(demand_theta+g_theta)/V)+R_M-G)]/D
if hypot(alpha_ref,beta_ref)>incidence_limit: retain angle direction and solve rate_ref=-s*[(F_eff-F_x-m*g_x)*theta_ref+R_F-(F_control/M_control)*(R_M-G)+m*g_theta]/[m*V-s*F_control*M_rate/M_control]
x=[theta,rate,actual_virtual_surface]; A=[[(F_angle-F_x-m*g_x)/(m*V),s,F_control/(m*V)],[M_angle/J_axis,M_rate/J_axis,M_control/J_axis],[0,0,-1/tau]]; B=[0,0,1/tau]^T
cascade K=[(J_axis*s/(T_rate*T_incidence)+M_angle)/M_control,(J_axis/T_rate+M_rate)/M_control,0]; closed_A=A-B*K only in frozen unsaturated residual-constant domain

equations: h=unit(v_own_estimated), u=unit(up), g0=9.80665m/s2; P_h(a)=a-h*(h dot a). unit(0)=0 in the native numerical contract.

For a tracking admitted measurement: l=track.direction, d=track.directionRate. If measurementTimeS is present, l=unit(l+d*(frame.timeS-track.sampleTimeS)); derivative d is not re-estimated by guidance.
c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

Only when the reported phase is Midcourse and inertialMidcourse=true: a_s+=sin(clamp(loftRad,0,0.7))*loftAccelerationG*g0*(u-h*(u dot h)); a Lost terminal latch suppresses loft, not permitted inertial estimate fallback.
z=P_h(a_s)+g0*u; G=maxG*g0; command=z when norm(z)<=G, otherwise command=G*z/norm(z). Gravity is included before the total-vector bound.

terminal_next=terminal_previous OR (engineering.version==3 AND tracking); phase=Homing if tracking, else Lost if terminal_next or retained track localId, else Midcourse if estimate present, else Seeking. c=norm(v_own_estimated) when rangeRateMs is absent; otherwise c=max(0,-rangeRateMs), including zero/opening clamp with no own-speed fallback.
Tracking steering is zero when rateAvailable=false, otherwise a_s=N*c*((l cross d) cross h)=N*c*(d*(l dot h)-l*(d dot h)). This is not generally N*c*P_h(d).
With a positive measured c and measured range, timeToGo=range/c; absent/nonpositive measured closing leaves timeToGo unavailable, even when the bearing branch uses own speed.
Permitted midcourse: p_est=e.position+e.velocity*(frame.timeS-e.sampleTimeS), r=p_est-own_position, R=norm(r), l_r=unit(r), v_rel=e.velocity-own_velocity, c_r=-v_rel dot l_r.
For inertialMidcourse=true, no tracked measurement, R>0 and c_r>0: a_s=N*c_r*(((l_r cross v_rel)/R) cross h); timeToGo=R/c_r. Otherwise midcourse PN is zero.

pitch s=+1, theta=alpha, rate=q, transverse=z; yaw s=-1, theta=beta, rate=r, transverse=y

R_F=F_measured_theta-F_angle*theta-F_control*delta_actual; R_M=M_measured_axis-M_angle*theta-M_rate*rate-M_control*delta_actual; G=(omega cross J*omega)_axis
rate_ref=-s*(demand_theta+g_theta)/V+s*(demand_x+g_x)*theta_ref/V
(F_angle-F_x+m*demand_x)*theta_ref+F_control*delta_trim+R_F=m*demand_theta; M_angle*theta_ref+M_rate*rate_ref+M_control*delta_trim+R_M-G=0
D=F_angle-F_control*M_angle/M_control-F_x+m*demand_x-s*F_control*M_rate*(demand_x+g_x)/(M_control*V)
theta_ref=[m*demand_theta-R_F+(F_control/M_control)*(M_rate*(-s*(demand_theta+g_theta)/V)+R_M-G)]/D
if hypot(alpha_ref,beta_ref)>incidence_limit: retain angle direction and solve rate_ref=-s*[(F_eff-F_x-m*g_x)*theta_ref+R_F-(F_control/M_control)*(R_M-G)+m*g_theta]/[m*V-s*F_control*M_rate/M_control]

cascade K=[(J_axis*s/(T_rate*T_incidence)+M_angle)/M_control,(J_axis/T_rate+M_rate)/M_control,0]; closed_A=A-B*K only in frozen unsaturated residual-constant domain
